_comment: Set "laptops" to the number of team laptops (2-6). Each laptop sets its own number in .claude/role.local.json (git-ignored), e.g. {"laptop": "L2"}. Hooks and skills read this file.

CORE.title: Coordinator: runs the bot network (messages, log, docs freshness), merges PRs, runs the shared server. Writes no feature code

W1.title: Terrain: LOLA DEM reader + horizon mask

W2.title: Metrics + API: earthrise/sunrise, /api/compare, validation vs PGDA

W3.title: Frontend: sky plot, horizon panorama, side-by-side compare

W4.title: Research + accuracy: how exact are our numbers (ephemeris vs JPL Horizons, horizon/illumination vs PGDA maps, DEM resolution and proxy-coordinate error budget), validation table for the pitch, sites.json, project page texts (EN)

W5.title: Media: demo recording script, DaVinci edit, 7 slides, local pitch
W5.ai: mostly human, Claude for the recording script

QA.title: Testing on the shared server, bug reports, incognito link checks

_machines: STRONG laptops: L1, L2 (Saturday) + L6 (arrives Sunday). They do Rust builds, the shared server, Claude work and DaVinci. L3-L5 are LIGHT (integrated graphics): browser, Antigravity, docs, testing. Set "machine": "strong"|"light" in role.local.json; the session hook warns on a mismatch. Saturday: "laptops": 5. Sunday when L6 arrives: "laptops": 6 (W5 moves from L2 to L6).
